description: Removal of rear balcony, sub-basement stair and erection of a single storey rear extension and insertion of a rooflight at first floor level and internal alterations
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning, Heritage and Design and Access Statement, 26HT_PLN_E01, Unnumbered Location Plan, Unnumbered Block Plan, 26HT_PLN_P01: Received 08/07/2019. 
Environment Agency Flood Risk Matrix, Flood risk addendum submitted with Householder EA flood risk assessment matrix: Received 07/09/2019. 
26HT_PLN_P01: Received 11/09/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
